baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural writings at word 2 and their q-w-m adjective at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: K-t-b supplies both assembled parts and letters joined as writing, while q-w-m supplies straightness and evenness. The phrase therefore presents multiple written units whose rightness includes coherent internal arrangement.

activation_trace.role: Joining one thing to another makes the plural writings an integrated assembly rather than a loose heap.
Letters joined into a written object fixes the assembly specifically in textual form.
Straightness, balance, and just speech make coherence an upright normative arrangement.

changed_reading.before: Books that are simply good or correct.
changed_reading.after: A plurality of written units whose joined components form a coherent, upright arrangement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same k-t-b noun can denote binding inscription, and the q-w-m adjective can denote guardianship and support.
baseline_models.mechanism: An inscription that imposes judgment is paired with what maintains, governs, and keeps a thing standing. The writings are therefore potentially operative instruments that establish and sustain an order, not merely descriptions of one.

activation_trace.role: Binding decree turns writing into an effective prescription or settled judgment.
Care, guardianship, and maintenance give the adjective an active order-preserving role.
Mainstay and subsistence make the writings supports by which a larger system remains standing.

changed_reading.after: Binding inscriptions that actively maintain and support a durable order.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural k-t-b form can evoke registered entries, while q-w-m includes valuation and exact measure.
baseline_models.mechanism: Registration, appraisal, and equal measure combine into a documentary mechanism: the writings can be read as records that assign standing according to a stable scale.

activation_trace.role: Entry into a register supplies the documentary act of placing persons or matters into an ordered record.
Value and appraisal supply the scale by which registered entries receive standing.
Equal weight and exact measure constrain appraisal to a balanced standard.

changed_reading.after: Writings functioning as an appraised register whose entries are set by exact measure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier singular book serves as a marker of group belonging, but the focus shifts to indefinite plural writings and qualifies their internal standing. This relocates attention from inherited affiliation with a book to the articulated contents by which such affiliation can be assessed.

activation_trace.role: Joined components make the focus plural an inspectable internal assembly.
Straightness supplies the criterion applied to those internal written units.
Nearness and belonging make the earlier book phrase a social affiliation label.
The singular written book is the object around which that affiliation is named.

structural_cues: 98:1 places the belonging term before a definite singular book, whereas 98:3 uses an indefinite plural of writings inside fiha.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies social belonging, singular book, and the later plural; I supply the arrow from title-based affiliation to content-based assessment. A live alternative is ordinary number variation with no deliberate relocation of authority.

changed_reading.before: Books as possessions confirming an already named textual community.
changed_reading.after: The internal written units, rather than the community label alone, become the locus where uprightness is tested.

context_deltas.mechanism: Following in sequence, written sheets, and removal of contamination turn the focus writings into ordered recitation units. Their uprightness is not only a property of stored objects; it is integrity preserved as textual parts are voiced one after another.

activation_trace.role: Joined letters anchor the focus in discrete written textual objects.
Straightness and evenness become integrity maintained through ordered delivery.
Following and succession supply the temporal process that carries one textual unit after another.
The written sheet supplies the immediate material container for the focus writings.
Purity as removal of stain makes uncontaminated transmission part of textual uprightness.

structural_cues: The feminine plural sheets in 98:2 provide the immediate antecedent for the focus pronoun fiha.
The recitation verb precedes the sheets and the contents they hold.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sequence, written sheets, purity, and pronominal containment; I supply the arrow that uprightness is preserved through recited transmission. The live alternative is that purity describes only the sheets while the writings remain static contents.

changed_reading.before: Coherent books considered as stored written objects.
changed_reading.after: Ordered textual units whose coherence and purity remain standing as they pass through recitation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus joins textual parts and calls their arrangement straight; the later context places possession of the written book beside manifest evidence and subsequent dispersal. Upright textual coherence therefore does not mechanically produce social unity: it can instead expose fragmentation by giving disagreement a clear common axis.

activation_trace.role: Joining supplies the internal coherence against which external dispersal becomes contrastive.
Straightness gives the coherent text a stable axis rather than making it one faction among others.
Scattering into parts supplies the social inverse of the focus writings joined from parts.
The repeated written-book branch keeps fragmentation adjacent to textual possession.
Manifest disclosure removes obscurity, so the ensuing division cannot be modeled simply as lack of information.

structural_cues: 98:4 marks dispersal as occurring only after the evidence came.
The focus lies between the arrival of evidence and the report of post-evidence division.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies joined writing, manifest evidence, and later scattering; I supply the contrastive arrow that textual coherence makes social incoherence legible. A live alternative is that the evidence and the focus writings are adjacent but not the operative axis of division.

changed_reading.before: Upright writings whose clarity should straightforwardly unify their hearers.
changed_reading.after: A coherent textual axis that can reveal and intensify the visibility of human fragmentation after clarity arrives.

context_deltas.mechanism: Binding inscription meets obligation, obedient practice, repeated establishment, and growth through purification. The writings function like an executable regimen: their uprightness is realized by acts that repeatedly maintain the order they prescribe.

activation_trace.role: A binding decree makes the focus writings capable of prescribing conduct.
Maintenance and persevering care define uprightness as ongoing performance.
Request and obligation supply the directive force that activates the writings.
Obedience and willing submission turn directive content into a lived ordering relation.
The repeated root joins establishing a practice to the final q-w-m qualification through maintenance and perseverance.
Growth and increase make the maintained regimen productive rather than merely restrictive.

structural_cues: 98:5 coordinates worship, sincerity, establishing prayer, and giving alms before naming this the q-w-m religion.
The root q-w-m recurs in both the establishment verb and the closing qualification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies command, obedience, repeated q-w-m, and productive purification; I supply the arrow that these acts instantiate what the focus writings prescribe. A live alternative is that 98:5 summarizes a religion without distributing those practices among the plural writings.

changed_reading.before: Binding texts whose correctness is chiefly propositional.
changed_reading.after: Operative prescriptions whose uprightness consists in sustaining a repeated and productive pattern of practice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same created class is placed under opposed worst and best predicates. This symmetry activates the focus branches of registration, valuation, and equal measure: the writings can function as a stable appraisal register that assigns comparative standing within one denominator.

activation_trace.role: Registration supplies the documentary placement of evaluated subjects into a class.
Appraisal supplies a comparative scale rather than merely intrinsic textual worth.
Exact equal weight constrains the opposed assessments to a common measure.
Evil and harm supply the negative pole of the appraisal.
Created beings supply the shared class within which the negative standing is assigned.
Excellence and selection supply the positive pole of the appraisal.
The repeated created class holds both poles to the same denominator.

structural_cues: 98:6 and 98:7 repeat the frame ulaika hum ... al-bariyya while reversing sharr and khayr.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired superlatives over the same class; I supply the arrow that this realizes the focus register-and-valuation branches. A live alternative is a moral contrast with no documentary or registry implication.

changed_reading.before: Writings that themselves possess high value.
changed_reading.after: Writings that provide a balanced register for assigning opposed standings within a common created class.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recompense, continuing provision, permanence, and reciprocal acceptance add a fulfillment side to binding writing. The writings do not only impose an order; they can encode a settlement whose prescribed relation returns as durable support and mutual satisfaction.

activation_trace.role: Binding inscription supplies the settled commitment whose outcome can later be fulfilled.
Support and subsistence connect uprightness to an order that continues to sustain its participants.
A deed met by its corresponding return supplies the settlement's responsive consequence.
Continuing provision makes fulfillment an ongoing support rather than a single payment.
Stable persistence protects the fulfilled order from rapid dissolution.
Mutual acceptance turns a one-direction decree into a reciprocally settled relation.

structural_cues: 98:8 moves from named recompense through flowing provision and permanence to a two-direction satisfaction construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recompense, continuance, permanence, and mutual acceptance; I supply the arrow that these are the fulfillment side of binding and sustaining writings. A live alternative is that the outcomes confirm the writings without contributing to the sense of their q-w-m quality.

changed_reading.after: Standing commitments whose enacted order resolves into durable provision and reciprocal settlement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it couples a specialized manumission-contract branch with a release-from-bondage branch; it remains anchored in the focus k-t-b noun and q-w-m adjective and is unusually reinforced by the packet's f-k-k context. Render it only as a legal-material analogy for effective writing, not as a claim that the surface plural lexically means manumission contracts.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The k-t-b writing at word 2 carries a contract-for-release branch, while q-w-m at word 3 can maintain the binding terms.

activation_trace.role: A written manumission contract contributes a binding instrument whose performance produces release.
Guardianship and maintenance make the instrument effective by keeping its terms in force.
Release of a pledge or neck from confinement supplies the outcome toward which the written instrument works.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, binding release-instruments whose terms must stand in order to redeem and open an entanglement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the q-w-m branch of an intact but sightless eye as a negative diagnostic image. It remains valid as an anchored contrast sharpened by covering and disclosure in 98:1, but downstream prose should present it as an analogy distinguishing formal survival from functioning clarity, never as a lexical gloss of qayyima.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The q-w-m adjective at word 3 includes the edge image of an eye that remains physically standing after sight is lost.

activation_trace.role: The written object supplies the potentially intact textual form under diagnosis.
An intact standing eye without sight supplies the negative possibility of preserved form with lost function.
Covering supplies the mechanism by which an available form can fail to disclose.
Manifest emergence supplies the contrasting function that an upright writing must actually perform.

changed_reading.before: Any intact and transmitted written form can count as upright.
changed_reading.after: A text may remain outwardly standing yet be functionally blind; upright writing must also remain capable of disclosure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant t-l-l mapping for the recitation root and combines elevation with toppling. The split mapping is explicitly packet-supplied and q-w-m gives a direct standing anchor, so the spatial activation is worth retaining; render it as speculative branch play, not as an etymology or translation of the recitation verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The written units at word 2 are called q-w-m at word 3, directly supporting an upright-versus-toppled spatial test.

activation_trace.role: Joined letters provide the textual forms subjected to the spatial stress image.
Bodily upright standing supplies the focus-side vertical orientation.
The non-dominant elevated-mound image raises recited textual units into visible relief.
The paired toppling image supplies the counterforce that tests whether those units remain upright.

changed_reading.before: Recitation merely transmits already upright writings.
changed_reading.after: Speculatively, recitation raises writings into relief and stress-tests which textual forms remain standing rather than topple.

strongest_changes: The sheets and recitation sequence turn the writings from stored objects into ordered units whose integrity persists through delivery.
The post-evidence dispersal reverses a simple unity model: internally joined writings can expose externally scattered reception.
The q-w-m recurrence in enacted practice makes uprightness operational and sustaining, not merely descriptive.
The opposed appraisals and durable recompense activate registry, measure, and fulfilled-settlement dimensions.
summary.what_was_special: The very short focus phrase behaved as a hinge between two rich branch systems: k-t-b moved among assembly, inscription, decree, registry, and contract, while q-w-m moved among straightness, maintenance, support, valuation, and standing. Context did not collapse these into one gloss; it made several mechanisms independently functional.
remaining_uncertainties: The context strongly suggests the sheets as the referent of fiha, but the exact distributive relation between sheets and plural writings remains open.
Straightness, active maintenance, and appraisal all fit q-w-m; the packet does not force one to exhaust the adjective.
The contractual-release, intact-but-blind, and vertical-stress readings are branch-grounded analogies and should not be promoted to direct lexical translations.
